# `admin.repo.verify`

Verify a repository against its daemon

Site admins only. Checks the store row and the daemon registration and reports every check.

- Method and path: `GET /admin/repos/{id}/verify`
- Scope: `admin:write`
- Kind: `read`
- CLI: `rukie admin repo verify`
- MCP: `admin_repo_verify`
- ETag: served; send it back as If-Match to write safely

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | yes | `string` |

## Errors

`forbidden`, `invalid`, `not-found`, `unavailable`, `validation`, plus the framework problems.
